components.name: Button
components.description:
Purpose: Starts an action.
Use when: A person needs to do one thing now. Use Primary once per group; every other action is Secondary or Ghost.
Don't use when: Navigation between pages (use a link or Tabs), an icon-only control (use IconButton), or a second Primary on the same screen.
Props: Label, Icon, Trailing icon, Variant (Primary/Secondary/Ghost/Amber/Forest), State
Catalog: Button
Spec: Primary fills color/action/primary, Secondary fills color/action/secondary. Amber and Forest are proposed in-product variants (color/action/warm, color/action/success). color/status/info is never a button fill.

Spec: 32px target with a 20px Lucide icon (size/icon). Code must add an accessible label.
